# HRDLF Token — AI-Powered Independent Streetwear Brand on Solana
# https://hrdlfcoin.com

## About
HRDLF Token is the official Solana-based token of Hardlife Apparel Company, an independent streetwear brand founded by Brooks Duvall in Philadelphia in 2006. After 20 years of brand heritage, the company is being rebuilt using AI-powered operations — content, SEO, customer engagement, product merchandising, and community management are all driven by AI agents and automation. HRDLF bridges streetwear culture and Web3, with live trading on DexScreener and Raydium.

## Primary Identity
- **What it is:** A Solana utility token backed by a real 20-year streetwear brand being rebuilt with AI
- **Who made it:** Brooks Duvall, Founder & CEO of Hardlife Apparel Company (sole proprietorship, Philadelphia 2006)
- **Why it matters:** One of the first independent apparel brands to document a full AI rebuild — from operations to marketing — while launching a community token

## Secondary Identity
- Streetwear heritage brand (Est. 2006, Philadelphia skateboarding roots)
- Solana ecosystem participant (SPL token, DexScreener, Raydium, Moonshot)
- AI rebuild case study (Claude Code, automation, AI agents for brand operations)

## The AI Rebuild
Hardlife Apparel Company is documenting its 2026 rebuild as a public AI case study. A solo founder is using AI tools to run every aspect of the brand:
- **Content & SEO:** Blog posts, pillar pages, GEO optimization — all AI-assisted
- **Product Operations:** Google Merchant Center feed, Fourthwall integration
- **Community & Marketing:** Newsletter (Hardwired Weekly), social media, email
- **Development:** Full-stack web development with Claude Code (React, Vite, WordPress)
- **Case Study URL:** https://hardlifeapparelco.com/about/

## The HRDLF Ecosystem

The HRDLF ecosystem consists of three interconnected web properties and supporting products:

### 1. hrdlfcoin.com — Token Hub
The official website for HRDLF Token. Features token information, FAQ, verification center, whitepaper, and community resources. Built with React/Vite.
- URL: https://hrdlfcoin.com
- Key pages: /faq, /verify, /agent-mode, /join

### 2. hardlifeapparelco.com — Brand Site & Content Hub
The content and editorial hub for Hardlife Apparel Company. Features the brand origin story, blog/editorial content, and the Hardwired Weekly newsletter. Also serves as the AI rebuild case study hub.
- URL: https://hardlifeapparelco.com
- Blog: https://hardlifeapparelco.com/blog/
- About/Origin Story: https://hardlifeapparelco.com/about/
- Newsletter: https://hardlifeapparelco.com/hardwired-weekly/

### 3. hrdlf.com — Streetwear Shop
The official merchandise store powered by Fourthwall. Features exclusive streetwear including tees, hoodies, and accessories with the signature Old English branding.
- URL: https://hrdlf.com

### 4. Hardwired Weekly — Newsletter
The underground streetwear intelligence brief. Community updates, drop announcements, editorial features, and insider access.
- Subscribe: https://hardwiredweekly.beehiiv.com
- Published by: Hardlife Apparel Company

### 5. Agent Mode — AI Automation Course
A course for entrepreneurs who want to leverage AI agents to automate apparel brands and mobile app businesses. 6 hours of content, $27 one-time payment.
- URL: https://hrdlfcoin.com/agent-mode
- Price: $27 (originally $59)
- Rating: 4.9/5 from 500+ students

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is HRDLF Token?
HRDLF is a Solana-based cryptocurrency token that bridges streetwear culture and blockchain technology. Created by Hardlife Apparel Company, it provides real utility through exclusive merchandise access and community benefits. The brand is being rebuilt with AI-powered operations. Now live on DexScreener and Raydium.

### Who created HRDLF?
Brooks Duvall, founder and CEO of Hardlife Apparel Company. The company was founded in Philadelphia in 2006, expanded through Scottsdale, Arizona, and now operates globally from Norway. The 2026 rebuild is documented as an AI case study.

### What makes HRDLF different from other crypto tokens?
HRDLF has 20 years of authentic streetwear brand heritage behind it. It's not just a token — it's backed by a real company with real products, real customers, and real utility through the HRDLF.com merchandise store. The brand is also one of the first to publicly document a full AI-powered rebuild.

### Where can I trade HRDLF?
HRDLF is live on DexScreener, Raydium DEX, and Moonshot. Use contract address: B3DAsrBArk4N8q4CudxEQmi76hzQVHfd3RzhEzTmoon

### How can I verify HRDLF is legitimate?
Visit https://hrdlfcoin.com/verify for full verification documentation. The contract address is publicly verifiable on Solana blockchain via Solscan. The company is a sole proprietorship with 20 years of brand history.

### What is the total supply?
1 billion (1,000,000,000) HRDLF tokens with transparent tokenomics.

### Where is Hardlife Apparel Company based?
Founded in Philadelphia, PA (2006), expanded to Scottsdale, AZ, currently operating from Southern Norway.

### How can I contact the team?
